facts.contact: Contact form messages (name, e-mail and message), kept for 12 months.
facts.admin: Sessions and the audit log of the admin panel, used only by those who run the site; the audit log is kept for 12 months and the IP only as a hash.
facts.logs: Technical logs of the hosting platform (Cloudflare), kept for 3 days.
facts.cookies: No cookies or tracking outside the admin panel; no analytics.
facts.turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile protects only the contact page against spam.
facts.embeds: External videos load only after a click, from cookieless domains (youtube-nocookie).
facts.fonts: Fonts are served by the site itself, with no third-party service.
